record.what_it_does: Devin is Cognition AI's autonomous AI software engineering agent that plans and executes coding tasks (writing code, running tests, opening PRs) in cloud sandboxes, controllable via web app, IDE, API, or MCP.
record.auth_notes: Uses a principal+token model: Service User API Keys (for automation/CI) or Personal Access Tokens (human identity), both prefixed `cog_` and sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. No OAuth2 flow is documented for third-party apps; legacy `apk_`-prefixed keys (v1/v2) are deprecated and not supported by the MCP server.
record.access_notes: The Free plan's feature list ('Light quota to code with agents', 'Limited model availability', Tab completions) does not mention API or cloud-agent access; 'Access to cloud agents (Devin Cloud)' is listed as a Pro-tier addition, and the API creates cloud-run sessions via a service user created in organization Settings — implying at least a paid organizational plan is needed. Exact minimum tier (Pro vs Team) for API/service-user creation was not explicitly confirmed on a primary page.
record.main_blocker: API access appears gated behind a paid organizational plan and requires per-org service-user setup (not a simple individual self-serve signup)

evidence.quote: All API credentials use the `cog_` prefix format. Include your token in the `Authorization` header
